items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: Zeb, yeah. He was our regular kind of player.

ctx.x: Was he more your regular kind of player?

Yeah, who? Zeb. Zeb, yeah. He was our regular kind of player. Oh, I know. I know. He used to play... I've never seen him ever play... He used to play cland on the side like that. Really? Yeah. He played a cland on the... Oh, it! Yeah, the style is odd. That's right. He had a cland in there. He had a cland in there. He had a cland in there.
I don't understand. What was he... Was he any good?
